theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsOpen U → IsConnected U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball x₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball x₀ r → T ω = c * ∫ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T ω = c * ∫ x in U, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume
